# BNL Community Fixes v2.4.1

First-person replay camera improvements.

## Changes
- F3 first-person camera: fixed black & white rendering by copying deferred rendering path and disabling Camera.main effects.
- F3 first-person camera: weapon animations now play correctly (digging, shooting etc).
- F3 first-person camera: camera position and rotation smoothed to reduce bone jitter.
- F3 first-person camera: pitch and yaw normalised to prevent 360° wraparound spin.
- F3 first-person camera: FOV set to 120.
- F3 toggle: fixed toggle breaking after first use (Camera.main reference cached before disabling).
